title: Consent to Summoning Contract Dissolution
body:
Syntax: sealconsent yes | sealconsent no (or simply yes/no during the request).

When a sealing specialist asks two players to dissolve their signed summoning contracts, each affected player must approve separately within two minutes. No response or any refusal cancels the entire request with no contract loss. Approval removes your current summoning contract and associated Sage training and ends any active summon. The specialist's own contract is unaffected. You must remain together and out of combat until both players approve.
